sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, sitting top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town at home on Saturday. The league leaders arrive in excellent form, unbeaten in their last five matches (W-D-W-W-W), and will be overwhelming favourites against Alsager, who sit bottom with just 4 points from 10 games and have won only once all season.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture between mid-table sides, with Stafford looking to close the gap on leaders Sandbach after picking up a draw in their most recent outing. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table, host Eccleshall in a clash between two of the division's stronger teams—Bridgnorth recently bounced back from a loss with a win, while Eccleshall come into the fixture seeking to reverse their most recent defeat. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth, welcome Wednesfield Community to a local derby; Casuals are on the back of a win while Wednesfield have shown recent improvement with a victory in their last match. In-form Bilston Town (fifth, on a two-game winning run) travel to face Foley Meir, who occupy mid-table. Market Drayton Town host New Mills in a meeting of struggling sides, with Market Drayton trying to bounce back from a loss and New Mills enduring a poor run of form with two consecutive defeats. Cheadle Heath Nomads, second-bottom, visit Telford Town in a basement battle between two of the division's weakest performers this season. Barnton entertain Shawbury United; Barnton picked up a recent win while Shawbury are in severe form trouble with five consecutive losses. Crewe host Allscott Heath, with both sides occupying the lower reaches of the table. Finally, Brereton Social, mid-table, welcome Widnes Town to what should be a favourable matchup for the hosts given Widnes Town's alarming run of five consecutive defeats and their position as the division's lowest scorers.
